svg.title: Formation relative navigation, two estimators
svg.desc: Relative navigation of 2 deputies around a chief on a high orbit, from a real run of engine v0.40.0 on scenarios/gnss-ssv-formation-heo.toml (401 epochs). For each deputy, two bars: the relative position RMS from subtracting the two independent absolute estimates, and from the relative filter on single-differenced pseudoranges. Baseline 0.8 km: 5.1 m and 1.2 m. Baseline 2.0 km: 4.1 m and 2.1 m. The absolute filter is not consistent here: mean normalised estimation error squared 187 against about 3 for a consistent filter, so its stated uncertainty is far too small. MODELLED: a modelled study from stated inputs, not a measurement and not a service-volume claim for any system. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
